about: [C4] Proof 1 of WAVE_C §7 for II The Fight: hands off from the way in on. The lesson waits twelve seconds on a player who does nothing, then the fight is on; he puts me down, and down again; never a win. Each time the warning ('One more and you're down.') was up at least a second before, and the black says in a word what went wrong. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/fight_idle.json
